reasoning.step1:
1) Determine if document is an invoice:
- Contains many invoice indicators: "Rechnung"/"Rechnung" header, "Rechnung 2401684", line items, totals, "Endbetrag", "MWSt-Basis", "MWSt", payment terms. No exclusion indicators ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") prominent. Conclusion: treat as invoice.

2) Locate Invoice Date:
- Text shows "Stans, 2024-01-29" on page 1 upper-right and "vom: 2024-01-25" (delivery or order date). The invoice issue date is "2024-01-29". Take Invoice.Date = "2024-01-29".

3) Locate Grand Total:
- Page 2 shows "Endbetrag EUR 40.721,97". European format uses comma as decimal separator. Grand total value = 40,721.97 → numeric 40721.97 preserving two decimals.

4) Locate VAT / tax details:
- Page 2 shows "MWSt-Basis 37.019,97" and "MWSt 10,00 3.702,00".
- Interpret: Net (tax base) = 37.019,97 → numeric 37019.97.
- Vat.Rate = 10 (drop percent symbol per rules).
- Vat.Amount = 3.702,00 → numeric 3702.00.
- Verify that Net + Vat = 37019.97 + 3702.00 = 40721.97 matches GrandTotal — consistent.

5) Locate Sender VAT ID:
- Header/bank block shows "Darbo-UID-Nr.: ATU31800708" and "UID-Nr.: ATU31800708". Use Sender.VatId = "ATU31800708".

6) Check No Inference policy and decimals:
- All extracted numeric fields keep the same decimal places as in input (two decimals).
- No missing required fields inferred — each required field found.

Conclusion: fields to output: GrandTotal.Amount = 40721.97, Invoice.Date = "2024-01-29", Sender.VatId = "ATU31800708", Vat.Rate = 10, Net.Amount = 37019.97, Vat.Amount = 3702.00.
